The target video is live-action and cinematic, a narrow rain-slick alley at night between tall brick buildings covered in graffiti, pink and blue neon signs, fire escapes and steam, wet ground reflecting the light.
[Shot 1] A symmetrical wide shot looks straight down the alley, and <Subject 1> walks steadily toward the camera from deep in the frame, small at first, her teal hair and glossy black puffer catching the neon, steam drifting past her. The camera pulls back slowly ahead of her as she walks. As she comes closer, the buildings on both sides begin to move like liquid: the brick walls ripple in slow waves, the upper storeys bend and lean inward, and windows, neon signs and fire escapes warp and flow as the facades fold over the top of the alley into an arching tunnel above her. <Subject 1> keeps walking at the same easy pace, unbothered, glancing up once with a faint smile as the architecture bends around her.
